'''The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow''' is the second of two compilation volumes of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}} released by [[VIZ Media]]. This volume contains a selection of chapters from the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. As a result of this, many key events are left out. This sometimes leads to references to events that are not included in this volume. The chapters come directly from VIZ Media's first edition translation of the series.

==Important events==
The {{adv|Yellow}} volume consists of chapters from the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. It features the two opening chapters, {{adv|Bill}} and Yellow's battle with [[Lorelei]], two standalone chapters of Yellow traveling and the final battle between Yellow and [[Lance]].
